title: Implement opt-in sandbox command-service deployment

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text:
## Manager handoff checkpoint

Start from branch `feature/command-service-consolidation` at bookkeeping commit `4b4e5872e19deed3daf883861f817e4f923bfeb8`; the accepted atomic command-service code commit is `3d6c421743e3d5249aa773423f4e04df9e2792c8`.

Existing unrelated worktree changes must remain untouched and excluded:
- `.vscode/settings.json`
- `plexus/infrastructure/scoring_service/network_stack.py`
- `infrastructure/tests/unit/test_scoring_service_platform_stacks.py`
- Kanbus-generated `project/` changes from subsequent comments

First implementation slice is architecture/specification only: inspect current sandbox environment resolution, shared service-network foundation contracts, image handoff, command-service stack ownership, naming, teardown, and secret guards; write executable failing behavior/synthesis coverage; then return the bounded design and red evidence before broad implementation. Do not deploy, commit, push, open a PR, or modify the exclusions. Staging proof in `plx-925843` is paused until this task is reviewed.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text:
## Manager sequencing decision — deferred pending staging proof

This task is deferred. We will first prove the already accepted ECS command-service integration in staging through `plx-925843`, because the current code supports the long-lived staging path while a full sandbox path is additional unproven architecture.

No sandbox implementation or deployment is currently authorized. Reassess this task after the staging proof identifies the real operational gaps and confirms whether a full sandbox path has sufficient development value.
